name: statcli-make-fix
instruction:
/app/statcli is a small C command-line tool that reads whitespace-separated numbers on stdin and prints count, mean, median and (population) standard deviation, each on its own line as `name=value`, with the values printed to 3 decimal places (count as an integer).

Right now it does not build, and once it builds its own tests do not pass. Fix the project so that, from /app/statcli:
- `make` builds the binary bin/statcli without errors,
- `make test` passes,
- the median is correct for any input (for an even count it is the mean of the two middle values).

Do not modify the test cases in tests/cases.
